note: Heuristic patterns for an integration-safety scan. Detects patterns of misuse, never a guessed credential value. Not a PCI certification.

checks.title: Secret key in client-side code
checks.message: A secret key or partner/merchant Authorization header appears in client-side code. The secret key must live only in a server-side environment variable.

checks.title: Secret-looking value passed to payTheoryFields
checks.message: payTheoryFields must not receive a secret-looking value; SDK parameters must be supported by the cited docs for the selected flow.

checks.title: Raw card capture outside hosted fields
checks.message: Raw card data appears to be captured directly. Card data must be collected only through Pay Theory hosted fields to keep the integration out of PCI scope.

checks.title: Hardcoded credential-looking literal
checks.message: A credential-looking literal is hardcoded. Move credentials to environment variables / secure config.

checks.title: Lab and Live markers mixed
checks.message: Lab/sandbox markers (paytheorylab/paytheorystudy) appear alongside production/live markers. Confirm the SDK Import URL and keys match the intended environment.
